questions.question: Tiny magnetic fields generated in the human body along nerves are primarily produced by the flow of:
questions.explanation: Nerve impulses consist of transmembrane movements of sodium and potassium ions (ionic current), producing small biomagnetic fields detected in MEG.

questions.question: A transformer changes which physical quantity while conserving total electrical power (in an ideal case)?
questions.explanation: Transformers step up or step down AC voltage and current such that input power equals output power (Vp Ip = Vs Is) at constant frequency.

questions.question: Which component of a DC electric motor reverses the direction of current in the armature coil every half-rotation?
questions.explanation: The split-ring commutator switches connections every 180° so the torque continues in the same rotational direction.

questions.question: If the current in a straight wire placed perpendicular to a magnetic field is doubled, the magnetic deflecting force on it will:
questions.explanation: F = I L B sin θ. Force is directly proportional to current I; doubling current doubles the magnetic force.

questions.question: Lenz's Law, which determines the direction of induced EMF and current, is an expression of the law of conservation of:
questions.explanation: Mechanical work done against the opposing induced magnetic field is converted directly into electrical energy, satisfying conservation of energy.

questions.question: If a transformer has a turn ratio (Ns/Np) of 5, the secondary voltage compared to primary voltage is:
The total number of magnetic field lines passing perpendicular through a given surface area is called:
questions.explanation: Magnetic flux Φ = B · A = B A cos θ represents the total magnetic lines passing through area A.

questions.question: A temporary magnet created by wrapping an insulated wire around an iron core and passing an electric current is called a/an:
questions.explanation: Electromagnets produce controllable magnetic fields only while electric current flows through the coil.

questions.question: A step-down transformer is designed to:
questions.explanation: A step-down transformer has fewer turns on the secondary coil than the primary (Ns < Np), stepping down the voltage (Vs < Vp).

questions.question: Bank ATM cards and credit cards store encoded account data using a magnetic:
questions.explanation: Magnetic stripe cards contain microscopic iron-based magnetic particles oriented to represent binary numbers.

questions.question: In Fleming's Left-Hand Rule for electric motors, the middle finger points in the direction of the:
questions.explanation: Thumb = Force/Motion, Forefinger = Magnetic Field, Middle finger = Current (F-B-I mnemonic).

questions.question: The direction of magnetic field lines around a straight current-carrying conductor can be found using the:
questions.explanation: Grasping the wire with the right hand with the thumb pointing in conventional current direction, curled fingers show the concentric magnetic lines.
